Name: Tasha
Title: My under eyes finally look rested
Description: I’ve always had hollow, tired looking under eyes, even when I slept well. I started mixing a drop of Volufiline into my eye cream at night and tapping it just where the shadow was. After a few weeks the area looks smoother and less sunken, and my concealer sits way better. It is a subtle change but very real and noticeable in photos.

Name: Emily B
Title: Great for fine lines and wrinkles
Description: Adding in this product with a vitamin c serum and tretinoin 1-2 times a week has transformed my skin. Super effective at reducing fine lines and wrinkles, these three are the trifecta along with a good moisturizer! The difference between these photos is 9 months and I only added in the volufiline to my routine for the last 3. The results are astounding!

Name: Jeff Seagondollar
Title: Fountain of Youth
Description: I don't write reviews but I had to on this one! I did one side of my husbands face last night and look at the difference this morning! And as for myself it's been incredible! Overnight it looks like I got filler under my eyes and my whole face looks fuller! If you are suffering from a loss of fat due to aging this is the stuff for you!

Name: Cheryl Riley
Title: Real Transformation
Description: I was honestly skeptical at first, but Volufiline has completely changed my under eyes. Within just 3 weeks, the hollowness and dark circles I’ve struggled with for years started to fade. I look much more awake now. Those close to me keep asking if I’ve had filler, but i've only been using this serum. Very happy with my results.

Name: Syd M
Title: HOLY GRAIL SKINCARE BOOSTER
Description: Discovering the Volufiline 30ml Cosmetic Ingredient, particularly the 100% Volufiline Ampoule from France, has been a game-changer for me in my skincare journey. I've always been interested in enhancing certain areas naturally, and mixing this potent ampoule with my eye cream has been transformative. What stands out about Volufiline is its ability to stimulate lipid production in fat cells, promoting a fuller and more voluminous appearance. By incorporating it into my eye cream regimen, I've noticed a significant improvement in the firmness and plumpness around my eye area. Fine lines appear smoother, and my skin feels more hydrated and resilient. The ampoule's concentration ensures that a little goes a long way, allowing me to customize my skincare routine effortlessly. I appreciate the versatility it offers, as I can mix it with different skincare products to target specific areas of concern effectively.

Name: Erin E. Dobbins
Title: WARNING… IT WORKS
Description: I’m 36 yo and have had under eye filler in the past. This definitely works for me. I see more volume and fullness in the places I’ve used it (mostly on my face). Now for some unsolicited big sister advice. I also found this on TikTok. It’s really amazing. I feel comfortable using it after doing my reading.

Name: Gin
Title: results coming in
Description: I started adding a few drops of Volufiline into my peptide moisturizer and even mixed some into a small jar of lip balm. I apply it carefully under my eyes and on my lips after microneedling. After about 3 weeks, I’ve started noticing a real difference, my lips look fuller with a natural rosy glow, and the under-eye area is looking smoother and more refreshed. As a mature woman with naturally thinning lips, it feels amazing to finally see them plump back up. I’m excited to keep using this because the results are showing more each week.

Name: adil salam
Title: Works
Description: Worked like a charm on my eyelids and reduced my upper eyelid exposure

Name: Francis F.
Title: It's Been Working
Description: Tops are today and bottoms are the day I started using the product. I’ve been using this daily for about a week and a half now. I feel you can see a difference already. My under eyes seem to be a bit less hollow. I’m going to continue to use it and see how it works long term.

Name: melissa
Title: PLEASE READ!!
Description: 3 weeks and this has plumpled my lips from thin to a lip filler affect. They are beautiful. It really works it’s amazing!! I also used on my breast I’ve had to kids and my boobs no longer existed. It’s taken them from an a cup to a C!!

Name: Hania Zainulabidin
Title: Works amazing for lips
Description: I have naturally quite think lips, especially my top lip and I’ve been using this for a few days and it works so well, I’ve noticed more volume. My upper lip is now bigger and so is my lower one. I use the applicator directly onto my lips and then seal it with Vaseline.

Name: Alyssa Hackett
Title: Love it
Description: Great product have been using it in my nightly routine, happy with results so far.

Name: CS
Title: Immediate Results
Description: Saw immediate results after 5 uses. Mixed 1 drop with my cetaphil cream and 1 drop of rose hip oil. Applied carefully to my under eyes with a q tip. Be precise with your application . After 5 days my hollows under my eyes had noticeable volume . I have very sensitive eyes and had no reaction.

Name: Sarah
Title: Minimal Results so far
Description: Sow someone saying that it adds volume to any place you want, so, I got it for my lips as I wanted to make them a bit bigger. I noticed some results in a week, I will keep trying it over the next month.

Name: Sanjana
Title: Really works
Description: So far, sooooo good, don't want to jinx it, hope this says it all!!

Name: James & Heather
Title: Small but noticeable difference
Description: Subtle difference was dealing for half a year I have regained most of my volume and am very satisfied with the results it doesn't look too outlandish but I did take a while to respond to the serum.

Name: Jenny Plinke
Title: It Works
Description: I was hopeful that this product would work after seeing a few TikTok videos of before and afters. I’m glad I did take a before photo because I will say I wasn’t noticing the difference as I’ve used it. This is after 2 months of use. You can clearly see the appearance of hollowness under my eyes has reduced quite a bit! I add 1 drop into every application of under eye cream at night. I also use this at night on my lips, and feel like they’ve been extra hydrated and plump when I wake up. I will definitely continue to use.

Name: Genevieve
Title: hydrating & noticeable results
Description: I’ve been using this under my eyes because I have naturally hollow eye sockets, and I wanted to see if it could help. First of all, the packaging is beautiful and feels very high-quality. The serum itself has a silky, hydrating texture that absorbs nicely and makes my skin feel so smooth. After a few weeks, I’ve noticed my under-eye area looking more refreshed and less tired, with a softer, plumper look starting to show. Even though results can vary for everyone, I feel like it’s working for me and I’m excited to keep using it to see even more improvement.

Name: Sage Brandt
Title: i'm not sure yet
Description: bought this to see if it’s actually giving people these crazy results. i was skeptical. NO it does not give you results over night. i have been using this under my eyes and on my lips. i’ve seen some hydration and a pretty big difference in my under eyes. but im not completely sure 🫣. feels like an oil so i’ve been putting it on top of products at night. i’m going to keep using the whole bottle and see if i can see any difference.

Name: Maggie
Title: I'll keep updating
Description: Haven't used it long enough to see results, however I have had no problems and it seems to be good.

Name: Shelly
Title: MIX WITH SKIN SAFE FACIAL OIL
Description: Love Volufilline! I use it on my lips, marionette lines and under my eyes. I mixed a few drops of Volufilline in a lip oil for use throughout the day. Then mix a few drops with rose hip facial oil before bed for the face.

Name: Starboy
Title: Moisturizing
Description: I’ve been using it mixed into my moisturizer as an eye cream, and it’s been a great addition to my routine. It feels very hydrating and has definitely improved the look of my under-eye area. My eye bags look less sunken and the skin appears plumper and healthier. The results so far are looking really good, and it feels like a much more expensive eye cream without the high price tag.

Name: Caitlin
Title: this stuff works!
Description: I truly have no idea what they put in here or how it's working so fast but after one night of use I noticed CRAZY results. I've had genetic dark circles caused by hollow eyes my whole life and after one night, they're almost entirely gone. I actually look like I've gotten a good nights sleep for once 😭😭 It's also made my lips a lot plumper, and I put some on my right tata to even them out and maybe I'm biased but they honestly look even LOL sorry tmi but basically, it works!!!! Anywhere you put it it will add volume so make sure you're putting it precisely where you want it. I don't know if it's just hydrating my skin and making it appear plumper or if it's truly creating fat growth and I'm almost afraid of how well it works cuz like is it gonna come out that this stuff causes cancer... idk yall. Apparently this stuff only works for like 7/10 people but it is absolutely, definitely worth a shot, just exercise your best judgment!

Name: Diego
Title: Works
Description: Helped with dark circles under my eyes after 2 weeks you can notice a difference.

Name: Autumn L. Malone
Title: I swear it does something
Description: Used this for a few weeks and never noticed much of a difference. I don’t think it was effective. I will try another brand.

Name: m
Title: Tiktok influenced me lol!
Description: I’ve only been using it for a few weeks and can’t say I’ve noticed a HUGE difference, I’ve noticed my eye wrinkles aren’t AS bad, but no idea if I’m just being delulu. Also no bad reactions to this, and I do have extremely sensitive skin so that’s definitely a plus! Will try to remember to come back and update if anything magical happens.

Name: kwi
Title: This stuff works- with a few caveats.
Description: This stuff looks like oil. It doesn’t work well under makeup or play well with other products- but it will reduce that transition we tend to get in the under eye area that on or below the orbital bone, next to the cheek area. This will kind of plump up that area, making that transition smoother. Unfortunately, I can only use it at night, after I’ve applied retinol and allowed that to absorb. I’ve tried using in the daytime, but applying sunscreen or makeup over this is impossible and makes the product ball up. I do sometimes use this before a special occasion and apply it hours before that- then wash it off before applying makeup.

Name: T
Title: so far good
Description: I've been using this under my eyes of a few weeks and my under eyes do look fuller. it doesn't irritate my skin at all. it also comes with a cute container to mix your products and a spoon.

Name: David
Title: Pretty good
Description: used to it get ride of my fine lines and eye bags but it lowkey only hydrated my under eyes instead!

Name: Marisa
Title: Take before and after photos!!!
Description:
Extremely pleasantly surprised to say that this 100% works! I have been using it for just under a month and felt like I was seeing only a subtle improvement but from looking at my before/after photos the difference is crazy and undeniable (I’m too shy to actually share photos of my face so you’ll just have to trust me). My eyes and lips are where I notice the biggest difference, but my whole face looks smoother overall. Really excited to see what the two and three month results look like.

For reference I have been applying a few drops in the morning and before bed every day. Started on April 24th and took my first ‘after’ photos yesterday (July 13th). I usually apply it directly then wait 15 min before applying other products.

Name: Cindy S
Title: definitely works
Description: This definitely works. I use it with products that open up the pores like retinol and glycolic acid so that might help it out a bit. It might not work that well if you don't exfoliate. Definitely no longer need lip filler. This gives such a natural result and I don't have to worry about looking like a filler fish.

Name: Kadir Basaran
Title: Thank You for Your Excellent Product and Service
Description:
Hello,

Thank you for providing such a high-quality product and outstanding service. Everything went smoothly, and your prompt communication made the experience even better. I look forward to working with you again in the future.

Name: Nana
Title: Experimenting is key
Description:
I was initially a bit skeptical at first, but after two months of use, I have observed a noticeable difference in both my smile lines and the natural hollows under my eyes. I used to struggle with prominent smile lines, but by mixing Volufiline with a moisturizer recommended by my dermatologist and applying it nightly, I’ve seen substantial improvement.

Unlike some other reviews, I didn’t notice a difference in a day, but with continued nightly application before bed, the results became evident. Though I’ve considered experimenting with morning applications, as individual experiences might vary. A word of caution – applying it directly without a serum or moisturizer made my skin sensitive, so following the instructions is a must, especially for those with sensitive skin like mine.

Experimenting is key, and while I’ve mainly focused on my face, I’ve heard it can be used on various parts of the body too. I’m happy with the results so far and plan to continue using it, awarding it a well-deserved 5 stars. For those on the fence, I recommend giving Volufiline a shot – it’s certainly worked wonders for me!

Name: Giselle lucero
Title: I can’t believe this actually works !
Description: I use this with my charlotte tilburay watery cream it also reacts well with azerlic acid i apply everything sides of nose and i was using it on the inner corners of my eyes for hollowness it has gave me back noticeable volume in my face and also helps with wrinkles im 20 and was starting to get small smile lines because of smiling a lot and braces and it’s helping me so much !

Name: Lila
Title: Works but doesn’t last
Description: I haven’t finished the bottle I’m about 2/3rd through. Definitely works but if you don’t use it the next day, the results you got the day previously are completely gone. That could just be how my body is metabolizing the product. Good product though. I use it on my under eyes and my lips. I used it every night for weeks. Still light it but again even after weeks of using the product, the results do not stay for more than a day or two.

Name: Sinceray
Title: yes it works
Description:
so I’m 38 with my lips have always look 50 so many lines they’re big but they need volume. I got the remedy right here, Eos Chapstick put like three or four drops on it let it sit overnight. My lips are plump, soft and has more volume.
 give it time it’s a two week processes. I actually still use it every night and day. Definitely notice a reduction in my wrinkles in my lips you won’t be disappointed sis💋💕

Name: Ravvi A.
Title: Amazing!
Description: Definitely Saw a difference with Volume, could be a bit stronger but overall great product.

Name: Busenur temür
Title: good
Description: good

Name: Patricia Le
Title: Is it Working?
Description: This is my second bottle of this product, and I am not sure if it is working...I have a great skincare routine and I use this as my last step on areas that I want to plump such as under eyes, temples area, my 11's and forehead. It says to use it for 56 days straight and I was pretty inconsistent at first but for the past 35 days or so I have been using this religiously nightly. I have notice my lips are a bit more plump which is nice, the rest I am not too sure about.

Name: Tina Munster
Title: Working so far
Description: I lost some weight in my face and so my eyes kind of started sinking in and it started looking a little dark. I used this 4 times so far and I have noticed a noticeable difference. I feel like there is more volume and, as a result, the darkness has significantly diminished. I know it recommends to mix it with a moisturizer or some other skin care but I just raw dog this b right on my skin. I will say to use a q tip and be precise with where you put it because, by the time you wake up in the morning, it’ll be in your eyes and it doesn’t feel that amazing. It doesn’t burn, it just feels uncomfortable. Oh and remember to try not to rub your eyes 😌 overall, I definitely recommend!

Name: amanda
Title: Highly recommend
Description: I’ve noticed a severe reduction in the dark circles I’ve been experiencing for the last few years, and I’ve only used it for a few months. Effective, moisturizes, and I’ve barely used 20% of the bottle yet.

Name: OU812Shelby
Title: Big bottle
Description: Just started using. Shocked how big the bottle was for the money I paid.

Name: Chloe S
Title: Under eye hallows reduced!
Description: This is quite amazing, and I’m really wondering how it actually works. Have fairly severe hollows, and dark circles. Mixed some with eye cream in the tub. Then have been putting product on and adding cream on top. The skin under my eyes appears to have plumed up significantly. It’s really noticeable. Dark circles still there - it’s mostly color. But it seems to have made me look younger due to the plumping. Have used for about 2 weeks now. It seems quite amazing. I cannot tell how or what has plumped up my skin. I describe it as using really good eye patches, yet even if you use those every day the effects only last an hour or so.

Name: mb
Title: does wonders for the skin!
Description: I can’t even begin to explain how much this has changed my skin, I typically use it for my under eyes for which I have creases and the differences are very noticable and drastic, it’s recommended to use with a moisturizer I use the la roche posay one and my skin looks like glass

Name: lovefebe
Title: Did see some plump but i've only used it 2 days
Description: It came way faster than i excepted which is a good thing. The first time i applied i didn't think i would see an over night difference, but i did when i woke up it was a slight difference and i'm really good a noticing change so not everyone is going to see a difference right away. but since i haven't used it very long at all i gave it 4 stars so i wouldn't be fair if i gave it an automatic 5 star

Name: customer
Title: perfect
Description: I contacted the seller and he resolved the problems I had due to delivery issues.

Name: Joan
Title: It works, that’s for sure!
Description: You have to use a very small amount to avoid eye irritation as it’s very ‘watery’ and will smudge all over your eyelid area. But this absolutely helps with hollow eyes. You can even see results after the first night.
